source.notes: Scanned school paper printed as a booklet (PDF page 1 = printed page 1 on the right half; PDF page 2 = printed pages 2 and 3). The text layer holds only fragments, so questions were OCR'd and corrected against page images. Printed session '2018-19'; examYear taken as the later year. Time printed as '3 Hrs. + 15 min.' (15 minutes reading time; durationMinutes = 180 writing time). Candidates answer all of Section A (80 marks) and EITHER Section B OR Section C (20 marks each), so the pack's marks total exceeds the 100 maximum. Question 3 has no printed number or marks; its number follows the sequence and its 4 marks are inferred from the Section A total. Question 18 has no printed marks; 4 inferred from the Section B total.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
